description: Search the registry by name, identifier or a word in the definition, scope, boundary or test. Returns matching entries with id, name, layer, kind, review state, name_test and the first sentence of the definition. A term matches the start of a word, terms shorter than 2 characters are ignored and listed in the note. An entry matching every term ranks first; if none does, the closest partial matches are returned and the note says how many terms they match. Each result states its review state. Entries describe processes in general, not the present state of any country, market or asset.

layer.description: Layer: core, social, extension, corpus or crisis_type.

query.description: Name, identifier or words from the definition. Not empty.

review.description: Review state filter (versions 1.3.0 and later): all (default), accepted or in_review. The default covers every published entry and each result states its review state; entries in review are published and usable. With accepted the response says how many more matching entries are in review.

version.description: Registry version, for example "1.4.1" (a leading "v" is accepted). Default: the latest published version (1.4.1). Available: 1.0.0, 1.1.0, 1.2.0, 1.3.0, 1.3.1, 1.4.0, 1.4.1.

name: search_mechanisms

attribution.description: CC BY 4.0 attribution: how an answer that uses the entries names the source.

scope.description: Scope of the registry: what the entries are and are not.

title: Search mechanisms
